title: NatrixSMP
body:
Looking for vanilla SMP servers with cool plugins that enhance gameplay without breaking the vanilla experience. Preferably includes features like GodArmor, custom commands, quality-of-life improvements, and small optimizations to make the server feel more engaging and fun while keeping the classic Minecraft vibe intact.
